title: How to Set Up Access Restrictions and Rules in Thrive Apprentice

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice**.
Select **Courses** from the left sidebar and click on the course you want to protect.
steps.context: left sidebar and click on the course you want to protect

steps.raw_text: Open the **Access Restrictions** tab within the course settings.
Enable the **Restrict course overview page** toggle.
Choose the restriction type—for example, require a product purchase or a logged-in status.
Click **Save** to apply your changes.
Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice**.
Go to **Products** and create a new product (or select an existing one).
steps.context: and create a new product (or select an existing one)

steps.raw_text: Assign the course you want to protect to this product.
Under the product's **Access Requirements**, set the requirement to **Email subscription** or the appropriate condition for your setup.
steps.context: set the requirement to Email subscription or the appropriate condition for your

steps.raw_text: Open your course and mark selected introductory lessons as **Free Preview** so they remain accessible to everyone.
steps.context: so they remain accessible to everyone

steps.raw_text: Save your settings.

sections.heading: Setting Restriction Rules at the Product Level

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice** > **Products**.
Click on the product you want to configure.
Open the **Access Restriction Rules** section.
Configure the following options:

sections.heading: Understanding Access Rule Priority with Multiple Products

steps.raw_text: **Course-level overrides** — If you've set specific restriction rules directly on a course, those take the highest priority.

steps.raw_text: **Product-level rules** — If no course-level override exists, the rules of the product that the visitor is most likely trying to access apply.

Go to the **Design** section and open the course listing or course card template in Thrive Architect.

Open the course that contains the lesson you want to make publicly accessible.
Click on the specific lesson you want to override.

steps.raw_text: In the lesson settings, enable the **Free Preview** or **Public Access** toggle.
Save your changes.
